Binary Releases & Distribution

Precompiled Go binaries for Straitgateway eBPF networking, controllers, CNI, and CLI.

Package Contents

Each release archive includes the 4 core binaries compiled with Go 1.26.7 for Linux kernel 6.7+:

straitgatewayd
sg-controller
sg-cli
straitgateway-cni
